services.name: The Fishing Net
services.desc: Brainerd Lakes/Nisswa/Central MN/Gull Lake Area fishing guide Bob Gessell, also known as Bobby G growing up, will give you the satisfaction of knowing you have one of the more reputable fishing guides for your next Brainerd Lakes Area Fishing trip. Bobby G will take you fishing in his V2090 Warrior fiberglass boat

addons.name: 2 Hour Family Fishing with Guide Boat

blurb: Bobby G offers fishing trips in the Brainerd Lakes area using a V2090 Warrior fiberglass boat with a 200 Suzuki four stroke engine. The boat is equipped with power seats for comfort and staying dry while moving between fishing spots. He fishes multiple species and can take guests to the best action on various lakes or to brown trout streams about 1.5 hours away.
